title: Microsoft Copilot Chat: Tools menu in the prompt box
notes: claim 42: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft Learn identifies Researcher and Analyst under Tools, contrary to the briefing's repeated statements that the menu and its contents are undocumented. Microsoft also publishes licensing information for Researcher, so the claim that licensing terms for capabilities reached through the menu are unstated needs narrowing.

claims.where: What's changing; front matter: changes; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe the Tools menu, so its contents and entry behaviour are known only from the roadmap.
claims.quote: These tools are available in Microsoft Copilot Chat under Tools and can be invoked by the user anytime.
claims.fix: Replace the undocumented-menu statement with 'Microsoft Learn identifies Researcher and Analyst as available in Microsoft Copilot Chat under Tools; the roadmap describes selecting Tools to discover and trigger capabilities.' claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the Tools menu's own default state or what the menu does on arrival without administrator action.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu rollout default administrator action; Copilot Chat Tools menu default admin roles. Read roadmap, Manage Copilot Chat, Configure Copilot settings, Manage agents and Researcher FAQ. Researcher's default is stated, not the menu's own rollout default.

claims.claim: A Tools-specific rollout sequence is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu rollout default administrator action; 497298. Read roadmap and release notes, searching the latter for Tools menu, Tools control and 497298; no rollout sequence for this menu was documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated which users or tenants receive the Tools menu first.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu prompt box 497298 default rollout; Copilot Chat Tools menu rollout default administrator action. Read roadmap, release notes and Researcher FAQ; none specifies the first users or tenants for the menu.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published the menu's list of capabilities, so its contents cannot be used to brief the help desk from Learn.
claims.quote: Researcher and Analyst are first-party Microsoft experiences built on the same foundation as Microsoft Copilot
claims.fix: Replace the statements that no contents are documented with 'Microsoft Learn identifies Researcher and Analyst under Tools but does not give an exhaustive menu list.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps. Retain the advice to inventory the entries visible in a pilot account.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not specify administrator action for the Tools menu itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu rollout default administrator action; Copilot Chat Tools menu admin switch Microsoft Graph beta. Read Manage Copilot Chat, Configure Copilot settings, Manage agents and Researcher FAQ; no action for the menu itself was specified.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published an identity or permission model specific to the Tools menu.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu default admin roles identity permissions licence; Copilot Chat Tools menu data permissions autonomous actions. Read requirements, Manage Copilot Chat, Manage agents and Researcher FAQ; no menu-specific identity or permission model.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence, credit rate or meter specific to the menu itself is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu licence meter credit rate. Read requirements, Manage agents and Researcher FAQ; read search excerpts from Copilot overview and pay-as-you-go meters. Terms cover Copilot and capabilities, not a separate menu entitlement or meter.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether features launched from Tools carry their own licence or meter terms.
claims.quote: The researcher agent is pre-installed in Copilot Chat for all worldwide users. Find it in the left navigation pane alongside other agents, giving you quick access to research tools as part of the Copilot Premium license.
claims.fix: Remove 'Microsoft has not stated whether the features launched from the menu carry their own licence or meter terms' and 'Any terms of the features launched from the menu are not stated'. Retain 'Check each feature's own page before budgeting' and the narrower statement that no menu-specific licence or meter is published. Learn identifies Researcher under Tools at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/faq-researcher and publishes its licensing in the cited release notes.

claims.claim: The app block is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Integrated Apps > Available Apps > app > Block app.
claims.quote: Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps. ... Select the Available Apps list. ... Select an app from the Available Apps list to open the overview pane. ... Select Block app.

claims.claim: An API or automation operation for the Integrated Apps block of the Copilot app is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph beta Integrated Apps block Copilot app tenant admin PowerShell API; Integrated Apps Copilot app PowerShell Graph block. Read Integrated Apps and search excerpts for copilotPackage:block and TCM resources; neither establishes the Copilot app block equivalent.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Integrated Apps page limits its documented controls to Global Administrators.
claims.quote: The following controls on the integrated apps portal in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center are only available to Global Admins. Check your credentials before you proceed.
claims.fix: Keep the attributed Global Administrator requirement, but add: 'The Microsoft Copilot requirements page also says the AI Administrator role provides access to Copilot and AI administration capabilities without requiring Global Administrator permissions.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/microsoft-copilot-requirements so readers can see the differing role guidance.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app through Integrated Apps withdraws Copilot Chat access on the documented app surfaces.
claims.quote: Users blocked through Integrated Apps see the Copilot Chat was turned off for your organization experience when opening Copilot Chat in the Copilot app.

claims.claim: Integrated Apps Copilot settings act on both Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat as apps, not solely on the Tools menu.
claims.quote: On the Integrated Apps page, the CoPilot app settings apply to both Microsoft Copilot and the Copilot Chat apps. Any changes made to this app from the integrated apps portal apply to both.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps page states that blocking applies to all users in the organisation.
claims.quote: When you choose to block an app, it is blocked for all users in your organization. Blocking an app overrides any previous admin deployment or user installation in Microsoft 365 and Outlook

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat describes the Integrated Apps block as tenant-wide and scopeable to specific users or groups.
claims.quote: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users.

claims.claim: The Integrated Apps page says Teams continues to honour its own Teams admin center settings.
claims.quote: The app is only be blocked in the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook. Teams continues to honor the current setting for Teams Apps made in the Teams admin center

claims.claim: Manage Copilot Chat says the Integrated Apps block also blocks Copilot in Teams, disagreeing with the Integrated Apps page.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.claim: App availability restrictions do not affect admin-deployed apps and are not equivalent to blocking.
claims.quote: The availability setting of an app doesn't impact any admin deployed apps. The availability setting only allows you to control which end users can install and use these apps on their own.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Copilot features as gradually rolling out to a subset of users within a tenant before expanding across the organisation.
claims.quote: Copilot features are introduced using a safe deployment model, gradually rolling out to a subset of users within a tenant before expanding across the organization.

claims.claim: Because the menu sits in the prompt box on desktop and web, Copilot Chat users see it.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Tools menu prompt box 497298 default rollout; Copilot Chat Tools menu rollout default administrator action. Read roadmap, Manage agents and Researcher FAQ. The record gives platforms; documentation identifies licensed users for Researcher, not menu visibility for all Chat users.
claims.fix: Replace 'so Copilot Chat users see it' with 'so users who receive the menu encounter it while composing prompts'. Keep the existing qualification that the roadmap does not state which users or tenants see it first.
